tools.description: Search Drint's library of ready 3D packaging and print mockups (about a thousand models: paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper bags, shipping cartons, bottles, jars, cans, cups, labels, flexible pouches, mugs, apparel, signage, posters, books, calendars). tools.name: open_mockup
tools.description: Show one Drint mockup in an interactive 3D viewer the user can rotate, zoom, recolour and resize. Take the id from search_mockups. Optional: colour (a colour or material name, or its number from 0), and a custom size in millimetres (length, width, height).

tools.name: list_dielines
tools.description: List the packaging structures Drint draws as print-ready dielines (tuck end boxes, auto-lock bottoms, mailers, FEFCO cartons, paper bags, rigid boxes, drawers, pillow boxes, sleeves, pouches, cups, labels…), with each one's type id and default size in mm, and find standard die codes: about 180 FEFCO

tools.name: get_dieline
tools.description: Draw a print-ready dieline at an exact size in the signed-in person's Drint space and return a download link (valid one hour): PDF / AI (cut and crease as spot colours with dimensions, opens in Illustrator) or SVG (CUT / CREASE layers). Give a standard code (FEFCO "0201", "0427"; ECMA "A20.20.03.01"

tools.name: make_dieline
tools.description: Draw a production dieline in the signed-in person's Drint space at an exact size and return a download link (valid one hour): DXF (for CAD and cutting tables) or CF2 (for die-makers, ArtiosCAD). Give a FEFCO / ECMA code or a type from list_dielines. Length, width, height are the inside size in mm. I

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: List the signed-in person's own Drint projects (in the space they allowed this app to use): name, products, last change, and their thumbnails in a grid they can click to open in 3D. Optional query: words of the name.

tools.name: open_my_project
tools.description: Show one of the signed-in person's Drint projects in 3D with its own design printed on it, in a viewer they can rotate and open in Drint. Take the id from list_my_projects. tools.name: my_drint
tools.description: Who is signed in to Drint, which space this app works in, its plan, and how many PDF / SVG dies and DXF / CF2 die downloads are left this month. Useful when a Drint tool reports a plan limit.
